newsitem.title: UK: Dec North Sea daily crude liftings up two percent.
newsitem.headline: Dec North Sea daily crude liftings up two percent.

text.p: Daily crude oil loadings from the North Sea's eight main export systems should rise by nearly two percent in December, schedules released this week show.
December liftings under the programmes would average 4.67 million barrels per day (bpd), 90,000 bpd more than in November.
Schedules for December liftings from Britain's Brent, Forties and Flotta and Norway's Ekofisk, Gullfaks, Oseberg, Statfjord and Troll detail 144.8 million barrels in 248.5 cargoes.
Loadings in November were expected to total 137.4 million barrels in 235 cargoes according to revised programmes.
